mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear and it is 79 degrees by Badger Ridge Middle School. We are under a waxing crescent moon tonight with an overnight low of 62 and no rain in the forecast.

The Verona Common Council has approved new sewer and stormwater rates to ensure our utilities remain self-supporting and properly maintained. Additionally, we are celebrating our local student artists who won the I Voted sticker contest, with their artwork set to appear at polling places in November.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with the UGM at Epic Systems today. Tomorrow brings trivia at both Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee, followed by a full lineup on Wednesday featuring the Farmer's Market and trivia at the Bogey Factory.
In our weekly report, on Saturday, August 15, officers arrested a woman for an O W I after she was found unresponsive behind the wheel of her vehicle.
You should definitely try the Caramel Peanut Buttercup flavor today, available until the store closes at 10 PM. Also, catch Kona Ice at Concerts at McKee tonight between 5 PM and 9 PM.
